name: game-hud
description: 8-bit HUD window above the prompt: LV/EXP, HP = context left, MP = plan usage left, G = session cost, a status row (HP LOW!, REST, SAVED, LEVEL UP!) with rest and save buttons

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: off hides the band; casual draws the window; hardcore adds the turn count

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: nes, gameboy and amber are made for dark terminals; theme follows your Claude Code theme (use it on a light background)

lowHp.title: Low HP (%)
lowHp.description: Show the rest/save row and a toast when context left drops to this percent

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: krw converts the cost ledger with krwPerUsd; usd shows it as kept

krwPerUsd.title: KRW per USD
krwPerUsd.description: Rate used when currency is krw
